title: Align panel: align and distribute selected objects
description: No align/distribute functionality. Implement the Align panel (Window > Align, Ctrl+K): align to selection or to stage. Buttons: Align Left Edge, Align Horizontal Center, Align Right Edge, Align Top Edge, Align Vertical Center, Align Bottom Edge; Distribute: Left Edges, Horizontal Centers, Right Edges, Top Edges, Vertical Centers, Bottom Edges; Match Size: Width, Height, Both; Space Evenly: Horizontal, Vertical. Toggle 'To Stage' to align relative to document bounds instead of selection bounds. Apply to all selected display objects in the active keyframe via pushDoc. Create packages/authoring-ui/src/AlignPanel.tsx and wire to Shell. See docs/04-toolbox.md.
